Agent.text:
I've restyled Atlas to look like the inside of Notion from your two screenshots, on the existing "Notion" branch. Nothing is committed or published yet. The colours are measured from your screenshots: dark grey page, slightly lighter sidebar, rounded menus and Notion's blue buttons. The sidebar now has a "Search or ask" box, a Home button, and your spaces with their pages underneath; an empty page shows "No pages inside". The page has a Notion-style top bar with a star for favourites, and a "⋯" menu with a search box, Font style (Default / Serif / Mono), Small text, Full width and "Last edited".

- **Checks:** the app builds and all 134 Atlas tests pass. I haven't looked at it signed in, because Atlas needs a login. I also skipped Craft Anything's likeness check, since it compares against Notion's public homepage rather than the app.
- **Another session:** while I was working, another session edited the same files with a similar look and then stopped. I kept its work and finished the parts it left half done, including the sidebar sliding out when you hover the left edge.
- **Still estimated:** the light-mode colours, since both your screenshots are dark.
- **Not done:** Notion's view tabs (Calendar, List, "New" button) and coloured tags from your first screenshot.

Next, I'd suggest asking me to give the Website space Notion's view tabs and coloured tags, and sending a light-mode screenshot so I can match those colours exactly.

Agent.text:
I made all five Atlas changes and the app builds with its tests passing. Craft Anything's check failed, but only because it compares your site's homepage with Notion's public homepage, not with Atlas, so I left that alone; I also haven't tried the changes signed in.

- **Arrows:** a page with nothing inside no longer shows an arrow or "No pages inside".
- **Page menu:** each page's "⋯" menu in the sidebar now matches your screenshot: favourites, copy link, duplicate, rename, move to, trash, open in new tab and last edited.
- **Table of contents:** clicking a section, or the Wiki space itself, shows its pages as a numbered table of contents.
- **Tables:** hovering a row or column shows a handle with a menu to insert, delete, merge and unmerge. Selecting several cells brings up a "Merge cells / Unmerge cells" bar.
- **Doc, Wiki or SOP:** each doc in the Wiki space has a Type you can set to Doc, Wiki or SOP, and the SOPs space will list only published SOPs. This needs one database change, which I've written but not applied. Until you say yes to applying it, the Type choice stays hidden and the SOPs space looks the same as before.

"My pages" already worked the way you described: only the owner can see them, admins included, unless the owner chooses to share one.
